description: What a bus route costs, per passenger type and ticket (cash single ticket, smart card such as EasyCard): the fare between two stops for coaches and routes priced by distance, or the fare per section for city routes. Example: city "InterCity", routeName "1610", from "臺北", to "高雄"; or city "Taipei", routeName "307".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, ChiayiCounty, Chiayi, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty, LienchiangCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, ...), or "InterCity" for 公路客運 / 國道客運 coaches between cities.

direction.description: Only one direction: "outbound" (去程) or "inbound" (返程). Default: both.

from.description: Where to travel from: part of a stop name, or a city, e.g. "臺北轉運站", "岡山", "高雄".

limit.description: Maximum number of fares to return (default 20).

routeName.description: Exact route name as TDX lists it, e.g. "307", "紅5", "1610". Find it with bus_route_search.

to.description: Where to travel to: part of a stop name, or a city, e.g. "臺北轉運站", "岡山", "高雄".

name: bus_fare
title: Bus fares
